title: Ephemeral backoff synchronizer and latency-snooze patch
author: Priya Shah
description:
Motivation: Recent incident (INC-4213) exposed an oscillation where regional transient failures caused aggressive circuit resets and immediate tenant-level retries, producing a spike in tail latency and cache churn. This PR introduces an 'ephemeral backoff synchronizer' (EBS) and a lightweight 'latency-snooze' window to reduce synchronized reopen storms and smooth SLO enforcement during short regional blips.

What this changes: adds a short-lived coordination layer in the control plane that injects randomized cooldown jitter and a bounded snooze interval for SLO-driven fast-path reopen decisions. When a node or region transitions from degraded->healthy, EBS delays tenant-level aggressive reopen attempts for a small, configurable window (default 2s jitter, 150ms snooze) so that KV caches and prefix caches have time to refill and scheduling probes can converge. Also introduces a soft tenant-shepherd backoff: tenants that triggered a circuit-based shed recently receive an exponential but capped quiet-period before being allowed to trigger immediate high-cost retries.

Implementation notes: the runtime changes touch circuit-manager.go (state coalescer and reopen gating), scheduler/tenant_shepherd.go (soft backoff tracker + metrics), and controlplane/sync_coordinator.go (EBS API + simple leaderless gossip-style token). Control plane exposes the new feature flag redwood.ephemeral_backoff.enabled and adjustable parameters: ephemeral_backoff.jitter_ms, ephemeral_backoff.snooze_ms, tenant_shepherd.quiet_ms_max. Defaults chosen conservatively to avoid user-visible slowdowns.

Testing and rollout: unit tests for state transitions and histogram-based latency assertions included. Added integration canary that runs against the perf-canary harness with synthetic KV pressure and induced regional flaps. Feature gated behind a runtime flag and staged rollout: canary -> 25% -> 100% rollout.

Checklist:
- [x] Core algorithm implemented and unit-tested
- [x] Integration canary and perf smoke tests added
- [x] Metrics (ephemeral_backoff.*) and tracing spans instrumented
- [x] Docs and release notes draft
- [x] Feature flag + config defaults

Related: Linear ENG-4213, ENG-4298; incident notes: https://linear.app/redwood/issue/ENG-4213/regional-kv-churn-incident
